records.cohort_raw: Top 33% of Stores (2 out of 6 Stores)
records.raw_text: The top 33% of Stores (2 out of 6 Stores) had an average unit volume of $469,457. The top 33% of Stores (2 out of 6 Stores) had a median unit volume of $469,457. The top 33% of Stores (2 out of 6 Stores) had the highest unit volume of $597,281. The top 33% of Stores (2 out of 6 Stores) had the lowest unit volume of $341,633.
records.notes: Cohort is top 33% by sales ranking. 6 stores qualified (open at least 11 of 12 accounting periods). 50% of stores in this cohort met or exceeded average of $469,457. Data reflects combined Traditional and Non-Traditional stores in TX and NJ. Unaudited, excludes costs.

records.cohort_raw: Bottom 33% of Stores (3 out of 6 Stores)
records.raw_text: The bottom 33% of Stores (3 out of 6 Stores) had an average unit volume of $85,159. The bottom 33% of Stores (3 out of 6 Stores) had a median unit volume of $104,174. The bottom 33% of Stores (3 out of 6 Stores) had the highest unit volume of $114,954. The bottom 33% of Stores (3 out of 6 Stores) had the lowest unit volume of $36,348.
records.notes: Cohort is bottom 33% by sales ranking. All stores in this cohort are Non-Traditional Stores. 66.7% of stores met or exceeded average of $85,159. Data reflects TX and NJ stores. Unaudited, excludes costs.

notes: Item 19 discloses annual unit volume for two performance-ranked cohorts (top 33% and bottom 33%) of 6 qualifying franchised stores open at least 11 of 12 accounting periods between Dec 30, 2024 and Dec 28, 2025. The middle 33% (1 store) is not separately disclosed. All data is sales only; costs excluded. Stores located in TX and NJ. Data is unaudited. No company-owned store data is included.
